title: Docker
outcome: Containerize the production API/web artifacts reproducibly with secure runtime configuration, small images, health checks, networking, and graceful shutdown.
artifact: Dockerfiles and compose/dev verification that build and run TaskFlow services from clean inputs.
labSteps: Write a .dockerignore first so local node_modules, Git history, secrets, and build output do not enter context.
Create a multi-stage API Dockerfile separating dependencies/build/runtime artifacts.
Build with frozen lockfile and inspect image layers/size.
Run the container with runtime env vars and map the service port explicitly.
Add healthcheck/readiness behavior and test startup plus graceful stop.
Create a small compose setup only for local integration needs and explain what remains externally managed.
failureModes: Running development server in production container
Container listens only on localhost internally
principles: A Dockerfile should produce a repeatable image from declared inputs rather than depend on a developer machine.
Use multi-stage builds to keep runtime images smaller and separate build-time tools from production dependencies.
Do not bake secrets into images; inject runtime configuration through the deployment environment.
Health checks and graceful shutdown help orchestrators know when a container is ready and when it should be replaced.

quiz.explanation: A Dockerfile should produce a repeatable image from declared inputs rather than depend on a developer machine.
